latest_release.body:
The one below is a list of all the PRs merged. For a more detailed update, read the [blog post about this release](https://coorasse.com/blog/cancancan-3-dot-7-0-and-4-dot-0/).


* Merge the `ControllerResourceLoader`, `ControllerResourceBuilder`, `ControllerResourceFinder`, `ControllerResourceNameFinder` and `ControllerResourceSanitizer` modules into `CanCan::ControllerResource`, and call the params method of the controller only once per request: it was called once more for every attribute set by the conditions of the ability. **WARNING**: the five modules no longer exist; override their methods in a subclass of `CanCan::ControllerResource` instead. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* Expand the actions again after `alias_action`, `clear_aliased_actions` and `merge`: `can?` kept using the aliases expanded by a previous check, so `clear_aliased_actions` did not remove `can :read` from `can?(:index, Model)`. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* Raise an error when an action is aliased to `:manage`, which granted every action, or to itself, which looped forever. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* Do not include the primary key in `permitted_attributes` for a rule without attributes, remove every attribute with a `cannot` rule without attributes, including those that are not columns, and accept a hash subject instead of raising a `TypeError`. **WARNING**: `permitted_attributes` no longer returns `:id`, and with a composite primary key none of its columns are returned. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* Convert a String resource name to a symbol in `load_and_authorize_resource` and the `skip_*` methods: `load_and_authorize_resource 'article'` treated the resource as a parent and authorized `:show` on the class instead of the action on the record. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* [#927](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/pull/927): Look up the unauthorized message of a String action through its aliases: `authorize!('index', post)` did not use the message defined for `read`. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* [#913](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/pull/913): Match a symbol in a condition with the string that has the same name in `can?`, as `accessible_by` already did: `cannot :read, Post, state: :draft` on a string column no longer allows `can?(:read, draft)`. **WARNING**: a `can` rule with a symbol now also allows records whose string attribute has the same name. ([@bruno-costanzo](https://github.com/bruno-costanzo))
* [#905](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/pull/905): Match String actions like Symbol actions: `can?('destroy', user)` ignored `cannot :destroy, User` when `can :manage` was defined, and `skip_authorize_resource except: 'destroy'` also skipped the authorization of `destroy`. **WARNING**: a String action now goes through the aliases like a Symbol action, so `can?('show', order)` and `authorize!(action_name, order)` are allowed by `can :read, Order` and may grant access that 3.6 denied. A rule defined with a String action now matches the same Symbol action, `permissions` returns symbols, and a block rule without a subject receives the action as a symbol. ([@bruno-costanzo](https://github.com/bruno-costanzo))
* [#848](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/issues/848): Do not deny `can?(:index, parent => Model)` because of a `cannot` rule with conditions on the model, as `can?(:index, Model)` already did: `load_and_authorize_resource` failed on the `index` of a nested resource. ([@coorasse](https://github.com/coorasse))
* [#861](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/issues/861), [#846](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/issues/846), [#690](https://github.com/CanCanCommunity/cancancan/issues/690): Give the conditions of `accessible_by` the table aliases that Active Record gives to the joined associations, and build them with the model of each table.
